---
name: SAP test report
about: Share what you tested with ZAKS Drive on your SAP system (worked or not)
labels: sap-integration, sap-test-report
---

<!-- Test reports are contributions. Never paste secrets, signed URLs (secKey), certificates' private keys or customer documents. -->

**SAP release** (for example S/4HANA 2025 FPS01, SAP_BASIS 816; on premise or RISE private cloud)

**ZAKS Drive version** (`zaks-drive version`)

**Scenario** (SAP report such as RSCMSTH0 to RSCMSTH3, RSCMSTA0, RSCMSTAC, RSCMSTAT, RSCMSTHS; or DMS CV01N/CV03N, GOS attachment, ArchiveLink, other)

**Configuration used** (OAC0 settings, document type and storage category, repository signature mode)

**Result** (passed or failed, and what you saw: SAP message, ZAKS Drive error code and request ID)

**Anything that was unclear or missing in the documentation**
